about: Seed project config for the factory kernel tools (tools/factory/kernel-subjects.py, kernel-receipt.py). Every key is required and no other key is allowed (K137). Copy it, then rename every value to your project's own; it NAMES things, it never decides credit.

contract_defaults.bar: the CI bar workflows (product-bar and tools-bar) dispatched at the exact candidate SHA and at the landing merge; each run is the bar of record for its SHA
contract_defaults.passes: 3 identical green passes at one SHA; passed, failed, skipped and excluded counted separately
contract_defaults.env: the bar workflow's runs-on as resolved at the run (Runner name {runner}); its Python
contract_defaults.harness-limits: the bar workflow's job timeout, as committed at the candidate SHA
contract_defaults.seats: 2-3 non-author read-only review seats, each with a different attack question
contract_defaults.review-scope: the packet's diff against master at the candidate SHA, and every reader of what it changes
contract_defaults.rounds: not capped by count; a finding blocks only with a reproduction at the candidate SHA
contract_defaults.planted-edits: every new pin is shown red by a planted break before review
